title: Validate planning values
responsibility: Validate identity, contract and author fields and normalize image rectangles.

inputs.name: version.value
inputs.description: A design version must match /^v\d{3,}$/: a lowercase v followed by at least three digits. This validator imposes no additional length limit.

inputs.name: text.value
inputs.description: Accepts only a string whose trimmed form is nonempty and whose JavaScript length is at most 1,000,000. Validation does not trim or replace the original value.

inputs.name: slug.value
inputs.description: Accepts a lowercase slug starting with a letter, followed by lowercase letters or digits and optionally hyphen-separated nonempty lowercase alphanumeric groups. It must be at most 64 characters.

inputs.name: planValidate.unitId
inputs.description: A unit identifier must contain exactly one dot, with a supported category (page, shell, layout, component, function, config, or service) followed by a valid slug. The category maps to its plural folder below src and the slug becomes the folder name.

inputs.name: contractHash.contract
inputs.description: A PlanContract has a nonempty responsibility, inputs and outputs with nonempty name/type fields, and errors/states/viewports arrays of unique nonempty strings; viewports are limited to desktop, tablet, mobile, or diagram. It matters when hashing a plan contract, whose complete canonical JSON is hashed.

inputs.name: author.value
inputs.description: A PlanAuthor must have kind person or agent and a name passing text validation. The validator checks this before accepting the author metadata.

inputs.name: region.value
inputs.description: A region is null or a rectangle with finite x/y/width/height values, x/y at least 0, positive width/height, and right/bottom edges no greater than 1. Coordinates are measured in normalized image fractions, and valid non-null regions are rounded to six decimal places on return.

inputs.name: filename.value
inputs.description: A safe artifact filename begins with a lowercase letter or digit and then uses only lowercase letters, digits, dots, or hyphens; it cannot contain '..'. This validator applies the rule to a filename string without directory components.

outputs.name: categories
outputs.description: The exported constant maps page, shell, layout, component, function, config, and service to pages, shells, layouts, components, functions, configs, and services. planValidate uses the mapping to form a relative plan folder.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: On success the assertion narrows the supplied value to string; it returns undefined and leaves the original value unchanged.

outputs.name: slug
outputs.description: On success the assertion narrows the supplied value to string; it returns undefined without altering the slug.

outputs.name: planValidate
outputs.description: Returns src/<plural-category>/<slug> after validating the unit identifier. The result is a relative repository path.

outputs.name: contractHash
outputs.description: Returns the lowercase 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the canonical JSON for the validated contract. Runtime properties on the contract object are included in that canonical serialization.

outputs.name: author
outputs.description: Returns undefined when kind is person or agent and name passes text validation.

outputs.name: region
outputs.description: Returns null unchanged for null input, or a four-field rectangle with each coordinate rounded to six decimal places. A non-null result comes from valid input within normalized image bounds.

outputs.name: filename
outputs.description: Returns undefined after the filename passes the allowed-character and no-'..' checks.

outputs.name: version
outputs.description: Returns undefined when the value matches v followed by at least three digits.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The fail helper throws a JavaScript Error (name: Error) with a code property and path: null. This unit uses invalid-input (Invalid design version, Expected non-empty text, Invalid slug, Invalid unit identity, Invalid contract fields, Invalid contract list, Invalid viewport, Invalid author), invalid-region (Invalid rectangle, Rectangle is outside image), and unsafe-path (Invalid artifact filename).

inputs.name: version.value
inputs.description: A design version must match /^v\d{3,}$/: a lowercase v followed by at least three digits. This validator imposes no additional length limit.

outputs.name: version
outputs.description: Returns undefined when the value matches v followed by at least three digits.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error (name: Error) with code: invalid-input, path: null, and message 'Invalid design version' when the value does not match /^v\d{3,}$/.

inputs.name: text.value
inputs.description: Accepts only a string whose trimmed form is nonempty and whose JavaScript length is at most 1,000,000. Validation does not trim or replace the original value.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: On success the assertion narrows the supplied value to string; it returns undefined and leaves the original value unchanged.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error (name: Error) with code: invalid-input, path: null, and message 'Expected non-empty text' for a non-string, blank-after-trimming, or over-1,000,000-character value.

inputs.name: slug.value
inputs.description: Accepts a lowercase slug starting with a letter, followed by lowercase letters or digits and optionally hyphen-separated nonempty lowercase alphanumeric groups. It must be at most 64 characters.

outputs.name: slug
outputs.description: On success the assertion narrows the supplied value to string; it returns undefined without altering the slug.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error (name: Error) with code: invalid-input, path: null, and message 'Invalid slug' when the lowercase slug pattern fails or the value exceeds 64 characters.

inputs.name: planValidate.unitId
inputs.description: A unit identifier must contain exactly one dot, with a supported category (page, shell, layout, component, function, config, or service) followed by a valid slug. The category maps to its plural folder below src and the slug becomes the folder name.

outputs.name: planValidate
outputs.description: Returns src/<plural-category>/<slug> after validating the unit identifier. The result is a relative repository path.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error with code: invalid-input and path: null: 'Expected non-empty text' for invalid text, 'Invalid slug' for an invalid name, or 'Invalid unit identity' for an unsupported category or extra dot-separated part.

inputs.name: contractHash.contract
inputs.description: A PlanContract has a nonempty responsibility, inputs and outputs with nonempty name/type fields, and errors/states/viewports arrays of unique nonempty strings; viewports are limited to desktop, tablet, mobile, or diagram. It matters when hashing a plan contract, whose complete canonical JSON is hashed.

outputs.name: contractHash
outputs.description: Returns the lowercase 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the canonical JSON for the validated contract. Runtime properties on the contract object are included in that canonical serialization.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error with code: invalid-input and path: null. Messages are 'Expected non-empty text', 'Invalid contract fields', 'Invalid contract list', or 'Invalid viewport' when the corresponding responsibility/list text, inputs/outputs array, unique-list, or viewport validation fails.

inputs.name: author.value
inputs.description: A PlanAuthor must have kind person or agent and a name passing text validation. The validator checks this before accepting the author metadata.

outputs.name: author
outputs.description: Returns undefined when kind is person or agent and name passes text validation.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error with code: invalid-input and path: null: 'Invalid author' for a falsy value or unsupported kind, or 'Expected non-empty text' when the name fails text validation.

inputs.name: region.value
inputs.description: A region is null or a rectangle with finite x/y/width/height values, x/y at least 0, positive width/height, and right/bottom edges no greater than 1. Coordinates are measured in normalized image fractions, and valid non-null regions are rounded to six decimal places on return.

outputs.name: region
outputs.description: Returns null unchanged for null input, or a four-field rectangle with each coordinate rounded to six decimal places. A non-null result comes from valid input within normalized image bounds.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error with path: null and code: invalid-region: 'Invalid rectangle' for non-finite coordinates, or 'Rectangle is outside image' for negative origins, nonpositive dimensions, or bounds extending past 1.

inputs.name: filename.value
inputs.description: A safe artifact filename begins with a lowercase letter or digit and then uses only lowercase letters, digits, dots, or hyphens; it cannot contain '..'. This validator applies the rule to a filename string without directory components.

outputs.name: filename
outputs.description: Returns undefined after the filename passes the allowed-character and no-'..' checks.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a JavaScript Error with code: unsafe-path, path: null, and message 'Invalid artifact filename' when the filename pattern fails or it contains '..'.
